scope: Independent standard-library reconstruction of the permitted paired string subtraction, all request/candidate mappings, opaque label-byte identity and token-array workload/pilot selection. No project imports, label decoding, score access, tokenizer, model or checkpoint calls. Token IDs are checked for structure/range/workload, not retokenized; tokenizer correctness and original public chronology/previous-value provenance inherit the authenticated preparation chain. Model/runtime/input descriptors and source files are checked, but model weights and earlier corpus payloads are not rehashed or loaded. This is paired-input verification, not cost-pilot admission or quality evidence.
